issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Prefactor
products.tagline: Evaluate your AI Agents in real-time
products.summaryZh: 实时评估你的AI智能体
products.descriptionZh: 大多数智能体在评估中通过，却在生产环境中失败。Prefactor 是弥合这一差距的评估层。我们实时对每次智能体运行进行评分，在质量退化和偏移发生时即时呈现，并向工程团队精确展示其智能体在大规模运行中的表现。专为向客户交付智能体的团队打造。
products.description: Most agents pass their evals and fail in production. Prefactor is the evaluation layer that closes the gap. We score every agent run in real time, surface quality regressions and drift as they happen, and show engineering teams exactly how their agents are performing at scale. Built for the teams shipping agents to customers.

products.name: Cekura
products.tagline: The self-improvement loop for voice agents
products.summaryZh: 语音智能体的自我改进循环
products.descriptionZh: Cekura 是面向生产环境语音与聊天AI代理的测试、可观测性与自我优化平台。它模拟数千种场景，捕获故障，诊断根本原因，重写提示词与配置，并通过完整回归扫描重新验证。与将故障交回给团队的工具有所不同，Cekura 通过自主修复代理并验证修复的稳定性（避免过拟合）来形成闭环。
products.description: Cekura is the testing, observability, and self-improvement platform for production voice and chat AI agents. It simulates thousands of scenarios, catches failures, diagnoses the root cause, rewrites prompts and config, then re-validates with a full regression sweep. Unlike tools that hand failures back to your team, Cekura closes the loop by fixing the agent itself and proving the fix holds without overfitting.

products.name: Lottie Creator 2.0
products.tagline: After Effects for the web, built on Lottie
products.summaryZh: 基于Lottie构建的网页版After Effects
products.descriptionZh: 是的，我们正式命名：网页版 After Effects。在浏览器中从零设计矢量动画，借助 Motion Copilot AI 提升效率，通过状态机实现交互逻辑，并导出可直接投入生产的 Lottie + dotLottie 格式。无需桌面应用，无需开发交接。
products.description: Yes, we're calling it: After Effects for the web. Design vector animations from scratch in your browser, move faster with Motion Copilot AI, wire up interactivity with State Machines, and export production-ready Lottie + dotLottie. No desktop app. No dev handoff.

products.name: Leaping AI
products.tagline: AI agents that call and text in multi-day campaigns
products.summaryZh: 多日营销活动中可进行通话和短信的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: 我们为实体运营企业（家装、屋顶工程、技工行业）提供自动化呼入/呼出电话与短信服务，支持跨数周的多线程营销活动。AI智能体可同时进行100+场对话，支持多语种交流，并能集成至任意CRM系统。我们帮助客户实现预约安排、客户服务及确认电话的自动化运营，彻底解决漏接来电、响应迟缓、线索跟进不足等痛点。
products.description: We allow companies that operate in the physical world (home remodeling, roofing, trades) to automate inbound and outbound calling & texting and run multi-threaded campaigns spanning several weeks. Our AI agents can hold 100+ parallel conversations, speak in multiple languages and integrate into any CRM. We help put appointment scheduling, customer service & confirmation calls on autopilot and eliminate missed calls, slow speed to lead and insufficient lead follow ups for our customers.

products.name: Hardbook
products.tagline: The freelancer booking link that signs the contract for you
products.summaryZh: 为您签署合同的自由职业者预约链接
products.descriptionZh: 商定日期与签署合同之间的空档，正是自由职业项目夭折之处。Hardbook解决了这个问题。你的客户在一个流程中选定日期并签署合同，无需应用、无需账户、无需催促。由一位自由职业者打造，旨在阻止交易流失并锁定工作。
products.description: The gap between agreed dates and a signed contract is where freelance jobs die. Hardbook fixes it. Your client picks dates and signs the contract in one flow. No app, no account, no chasing. Built by a freelancer to stop deal decay and lock in work.

products.name: Ycode AI Agents
products.tagline: Build websites with AI
products.summaryZh: 用AI构建网站
products.descriptionZh: 将Claude、OpenAI、Gemini或Grok连接到Ycode，即可在网站构建器中直接使用你偏好的AI。描述你想要修改的内容，代理即可为你更新设计、管理CMS内容，以及构建或改进组件。
products.description: Connect Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Grok to Ycode and use your preferred AI directly inside the website builder. Describe what you want to change, and the agent can update designs, manage CMS content, and build or improve components for you

products.name: EasyCircuit
products.tagline: Hardware prototyping, as simple as vibe-coding
products.summaryZh: 硬件原型制作，简单如氛围编码
products.descriptionZh: AI电路副驾驶，自动设计项目并采购零件——无需电气工程经验。用通俗语言描述需求，获取已验证的零件套件，分阶段从面包板搭建到焊接洞洞板。
products.description: An AI circuit copilot that designs your project and sources the parts automatically — no electrical engineering experience needed. Describe it in plain language, get a verified parts kit, and build it staged from breadboard to soldered perfboard.

products.name: Jotform Website Widgets
products.tagline: Build and embed no-code website widgets in minutes
products.summaryZh: 几分钟内构建并嵌入无代码网站组件
products.descriptionZh: 使用可自定义的无代码组件升级您的网站。通过评论、预订、聊天、弹窗、倒计时、常见问题、媒体库、公告等功能创建互动体验，然后个性化每个组件，几分钟内即可嵌入任何网站。
products.description: Upgrade your website with customizable no-code widgets. Create interactive experiences with reviews, booking, chat, popups, countdowns, FAQs, media galleries, announcements, and much more, then personalize every widget and embed it on any website in minutes.

products.name: Firstpass
products.tagline: Actionable input so you nail every launch
products.summaryZh: 可执行的输入，助你完美应对每一次发布
products.descriptionZh: 如果你曾发布过产品，却发现文案被截断、忽略或误读——Firstpass 会在你发布前，展示陌生人接触你产品的每一个界面（Product Hunt 页面、排行榜条目、Glaze Store 网格），并在每个界面中标注出问题的部分，附上手写批注。同一句标语在不同位置的效果截然不同：PH 限制 60 字符，Glaze Store 上限 40 字符，浏览网格则截断在 33 字符左右。没人会提前检查——直到上线才暴露问题。
products.description: If you've ever shipped a launch and watched your copy get truncated, ignored, or misread — Firstpass shows you every surface a stranger meets your product on (the Product Hunt page, the leaderboard row, the Glaze Store grid) and pins handwritten crit notes to what breaks in each one, before you publish. The same tagline lives or dies differently depending on where it lands: PH gives you 60 characters, the Glaze Store caps at 40, the browse grid cuts near 33. Nobody checks — until it's live.

products.name: FlowTask 2.0
products.tagline: Company brain for AI Agents
products.summaryZh: AI代理的企业大脑
products.descriptionZh: 面向AI代理的企业大脑。企业分散在邮件、Slack、WhatsApp和LinkedIn等渠道的碎片化沟通与数据，通过审批层整合至一处，确保个人与工作聊天不混淆，并可同时连接任意AI代理。记录每分钟持续更新，AI代理也随之同步更新，从而以更低的上下文成本使用AI代理，无需重复操作。
products.description: Company Brain for AI agents, Fragmented communication and data of a company which is left on channels Emails, Slacks, WhatsApp and LinkedIn connect it all in one place with approval layer attach so personal and works chats don't gets mixed and connect it with any ai agents simultaneously, where records are keep getting updated minutes by minutes and so AI agents are getting updated as well so use AI agents with less cost of context and don't have to repeat.

products.name: Superunit
products.tagline: AI agents that verify employment by phone, email & fax
products.summaryZh: 通过电话、电子邮件和传真验证就业情况的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: 每次有人入职、申请房贷或租赁公寓时，都需要有人确认他们确实在声称工作过的地方工作过。这意味着要向人力资源和薪资部门拨打数百万通电话、发送数百万封邮件和传真（是的，在2026年仍在使用传真）。Superunit的AI代理全程处理这些工作。它们会进行调研、打电话、发邮件、发传真并处理文件，直到验证完成。
products.description: Every time someone gets hired, applies for a mortgage, or leases an apartment, someone has to confirm they actually worked where they said they did. That means millions of calls, emails, faxes (yes, in 2026), to HR and payroll departments. Superunit's AI agents do all of that from start to finish. They research, call, email, fax and handle documents until the verification is done.

products.name: MCP-Billing
products.tagline: OAuth 2.1 + usage-based Stripe billing for MCP servers
products.summaryZh: OAuth 2.1 + 基于用量的 Stripe 计费，适用于 MCP 服务器
products.descriptionZh: 自托管 Next.js/TypeScript 样板：完整 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE、API 密钥管理支持零停机轮换、基于使用量的 Stripe 计费、Redis 速率限制。7 个模块，300 多项测试。一次性 €79，无收入分成，无平台锁定。计量核心在 npm 上免费开源。
products.description: Self-hosted Next.js/TypeScript boilerplate: full OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, API key management with zero-downtime rotation, usage-based Stripe billing, and Redis rate limiting. 7 modules, 300+ tests. One-time €79, no revenue share, no platform lock-in. The metering core is free and open source on npm.

products.name: Liminal
products.tagline: A workspace & 2nd brain for you, your agent, and your team
products.summaryZh: 一个为你、你的智能体以及你的团队打造的工作空间与第二大脑。
products.descriptionZh: 你的智能体以 Markdown 和 HTML 格式在本地编写文件，这些本就是它熟悉的格式。Liminal 能立即将这些文件渲染为简洁的界面，并实时同步给你的团队。分享一个链接，所有人就能看到同一个实时工作空间，并可在浏览器中编辑。无需通过 Slack 发送 Markdown，无需自行托管 HTML，也无需等待 Google Drive。没有 MCP 调用，没有专有格式，没有浪费的 token。久而久之，它会成为你的团队以及与你协作的每个智能体共享的第二大脑。
products.description: Your agent writes files locally in markdown and HTML, the formats it already speaks. Liminal renders them as clean UI instantly and syncs to your team in real time. Share a link and everyone sees the same live workspace, editable in the browser. No sending markdown over Slack, no hosting your own HTML, no waiting on Google Drive. No MCP calls, no proprietary formats, no wasted tokens. Over time, it becomes a shared second brain for your team and every agent working with you.

products.name: Conduit
products.tagline: AI agents purpose-built for Hospitality
products.summaryZh: 专为酒店业打造的AI智能体
products.descriptionZh: Conduit 自动化处理住客对话及其背后的工作。Conduit 智能体可在电子邮件、WhatsApp、OTA平台、社交媒体及语音通话中进行回复。智能体可调度子智能体在您的PMS和技术栈内执行操作：派遣清洁人员、更新日历、完成闭环。每个交互过程智能体都会学习，且您可以检查每一步。支持140多种语言，通过SOC 2 Type II认证。已处理超过5000万次对话，为包括万豪、希尔顿、Nobu和费尔蒙在内的300多个品牌创造了超过30亿美元的预订价值。
products.description: Conduit automates guest conversations and the work behind it. Conduit agents reply across email, WhatsApp, OTAs and social, voice calls. Agents dispatch subagents to act inside your PMS and tech stack: dispatching cleaners, updating calendars, closing the loop. Agents learn from every interaction, and you can inspect every step. 140+ languages, SOC 2 Type II. 50M+ conversations and $3B+ in reservation value for 300+ brands including Marriott, Hilton, Nobu and Fairmont.

products.name: Phantom
products.tagline: Voice-first AI agent that operates your Mac
products.summaryZh: 语音优先的AI代理，可操控你的Mac
products.descriptionZh: Phantom 是一款面向 macOS 的语音优先 AI 代理，始终可通过 Mac 的刘海区域访问。用户无需打开聊天窗口或将工作转移到独立的对话中，而是可以直接在 Mac 上的任意位置通过语音或文字输入，无需中断当前工作。Phantom 能够理解相关的屏幕和应用上下文，并在用户的工作流程中直接完成任务。其可能性仅受限于用户的想象力。
products.description: Phantom is a voice-first AI agent for macOS that is always accessible via the Mac notch. Instead of opening a chatbot window and moving work into a separate conversation, users speak or type from anywhere on their Mac, without interrupting their work. Phantom understands the relevant screen and app context and completes tasks directly within the user's workflow. The possibilities are only limited by the imagination of the user.

products.name: qsa.sh
products.tagline: External security scan of your own IP, in your terminal
products.summaryZh: 在终端中对自身IP进行外部安全扫描
products.descriptionZh: 运行 curl qsa.sh 即可对服务器公网 IP 执行一键外部安全扫描——naabu、nmap + vulners 和 nuclei 会映射开放端口、服务版本及已知 CVE，结果约 30 秒内直接输出至终端。清晰呈现互联网视角下的主机暴露面：无需注册，不留存数据。免费扫描实时运行；付费 Pro 版（覆盖全部 65,535 端口，异步执行）与一次性 Deep 版（完整 nuclei 全量扫描，结果邮件发送）可深入挖掘表层之下的漏洞。
products.description: Run curl qsa.sh for a one-command external security scan of your server's own public IP — naabu, nmap + vulners, and nuclei map your open ports, service versions, and known CVEs, streamed straight to your terminal in ~30 seconds. See exactly what the internet sees of your host: no account, nothing stored. Free scans run live; paid Pro (all 65,535 ports, async) and one-time Deep (the full nuclei firehose, emailed) dig deeper uncovering vulnerabilities below the surface.

products.name: Lamoom
products.tagline: Run agent apps inside your Claude or sell your own
products.summaryZh: 在Claude中运行智能体应用，或销售你自己的应用。
products.descriptionZh: Lamoom是一个代理应用市场，这些应用运行在你自己的Claude中，而非我们的服务器上。安装一个应用后，它会在你的文件中运行，处理你的数据。每次运行结果都归你查看。你可以发布自己的循环应用，按次或按月收费。新用户可获20美元免费额度。
products.description: Lamoom is a marketplace of agent apps that run inside your own Claude - not on our servers. Install one and it works in your files, with your data. Every run is yours to see. Publish your own loops and charge per run or monthly. $20 free credit to start.

products.name: RecipeBook by Shofo
products.tagline: Buy video training data by the hour featuring 25M+ clips
products.summaryZh: 按小时购买视频训练数据，包含超过2500万个片段
products.descriptionZh: Recipe Book 是一个视频数据平台，支持语义搜索超过2500万个片段，可对结果进行迭代，并一次性购买训练模型所需的确切数据集。搜索→对几个片段进行评分→我们根据你的投票训练一个探针，按你的偏好重新排序整个目录。无需填写联系表格，无需销售电话，每小时3美元。
products.description: Recipe Book is a video data platform where you can semantically search 25M+ clips, iterate on the results, and buy the exact dataset you need to train your model in one sitting. Search -> rate a few clips -> we train a probe on your votes to re-rank the whole catalog to your taste. No contact forms, no sales calls, $3/hour.

products.name: G.I.A.ac
products.tagline: Build real, working apps from a single sentence
products.summaryZh: 从一句话构建真实可用的应用
products.descriptionZh: 通用智能架构师——描述一个应用，并实时观看其构建过程。
products.description: General Intelligence Architect — describe an app and watch it get built live.

products.name: Cercle
products.tagline: The bat signal for your closest friends.
products.summaryZh: 给最亲密的朋友发出的蝙蝠信号。
products.descriptionZh: Cercle正在通过重建与重要之人的联系，来攻克孤独蔓延的难题。你可以关照自我状态，向密友或整个Cercle分享心情。让友谊不再需要猜测——在拨出电话或发送消息前，先了解他们的情绪。好友的心情更新会实时显示在你的主屏幕小组件上，让你在他们开口求助前就知道谁需要你。这款产品源于目睹多位挚友在沉默中挣扎的经历。
products.description: Cercle is conquering the loneliness epidemic by bringing back connections with the people that matter most. Check in with yourself and share your mood with your close friends or your entire Cercle. Take the guesswork out of your friendships, know how they're feeling before that phone call or text. Your friends' mood updates live on your home-screen widget, so you know who needs you before they have to ask. Built after watching a series of close friends live and struggle in silence
